sources.anchors: SCES296; sections5.3/5.5, partial-power description, DCK0005A pp46–48

host.source: RK3568B2 Rev2.3 pin table and Tables3-3/3-4; hardware design guide pp87–89. Preserve all canonical ball names. Pinmux must select same M1 functional group, with WAKE input and CLKREQ bidirectional open drain. Other27 VCCIO5 pins are unused.
host.pulls: RK default pulldown16–43k. R700/R7011.5k dominate it while keeping worst static pull-up sink current below3.1mA. Disable internal pulls in firmware. R70247k retains PERST LOW independently.

translator.ports: A0/B0 WAKE; A1/B1 CLKREQ; VCCA=S0, VCCB=ETH; OE tiedVCCA per application note4. Either rail1.65–5.5V, including crossing/equal rails.
translator.off_state: Both ports high-impedance if either supply0V; IOFF/IOZ max2uA over−40..85C. This is conductive isolation, not galvanic safety isolation. Test slow or interrupted ramps; no ideal isolation inferred at arbitrary intermediate voltages.
translator.logic: Data-input VIH=localVCC−0.4; VIL=0.4V. Both endpoints specify VIH2.0/VIL0.8 and VOL0.4. Source guarantee VOL<=0.4 at VIL0.15 and6mA does not cover worst endpoint VOL0.4. Figure6 shows typical transfer for0.4V input, with substantial expected margin to endpoint0.8V. Bench-check all corners and sinking ends before qualification.
translator.loading: External pull-ups required1–10k. Keep each port segment<=50pF target;13pF internal IO capacitance is typical. No added capacitors. AC max delays in datasheet use2.2k/50pF, so do not apply those max delays unchanged to fitted1.5k/4.7k.
translator.ICC: 5uA max per supply when inputs at rails; transition/partially biased current and pull-up currents belong in final power budget.

reset.buffer: U15 supplied from Ethernet3.3; processor input is5.5V tolerant even with VCC0. Input II5uA max, Ioff10uA max. VIH2.0/VIL0.8 at3.0–3.6V gives0.4V margins to RK VOH2.4/VOL0.4. Do not substitute same-name clones.
reset.condition: U12PG9, U13PG9 and U15Y4 are wired open drain to U16MR3. R653/R66347k pull-ups and both old PG test points now share ETH_RESET_CONDITION_N. Their former independent PG names were removed. Either PG low or host PERST low prevents release.
reset.supervisor: U16VDD6/SENSE5 use ETH3.3. Fixed3.07V falling threshold max±1.5%, rising hysteresis max2.5%. Worst rising3.193951V is below ETH DC minimum3.256156V. MR internal pullup70k minimum.
reset.delay: R703100k from CT4 toETH3.3 selects180–420ms guaranteed delay (300ms typical). R70410k pulls RESET1 toETH3.3; existing R67947k pulls the same U11PERST36 node toground. Worst HIGH2.65913V exceeds2.0V. Each valid condition transition restarts full delay, satisfying100us minimum assertion and10ms between releases for captured reset events.
reset.startup_bound: Reserve10ms after PG crossing for normal specified monotonic rail startup. The180ms minimum timer then leaves>=170ms after normal rail settling, exceeding100ms. This argument applies to the qualified normal regulator ramps; it does not declare an abnormal undervoltage plateau valid.
reset.clock: Host must establish continuous stable REFCLK before raising PERST. The timer adds>=180ms. Verify waveform lead>=100us with final clock/ASPM image. Reference clock off-state pin behavior remains open.
reset.shutdown: Assert processor PERST before intentional S0 shutdown. U15 is a plain CMOS buffer with specified input edge-rate limits; slow asynchronous power-loss input crossings and brownout timing remain qualification work.
reset.fast_fault: NOT QUALIFIED. TPS62813 PG deglitch40us is typical only; TPS3808 SENSE→RESET20us and MR→RESET150ns are typical only. None proves Realtek TFAIL<=500ns when a rail leaves specified tolerance by>500mV. Add a justified fast path or resolve implementation-specific requirement from evidence; no blanket waiver. Normal operating limits are3.14..3.46 and0.92..0.98V, so TFAIL should not be misread as500ns at the first microvolt outside the nominal window.

margins.limits: FXMA VOL max is specified at0.15V input/6mA. Endpoint VOL may reach0.4V; the data sheet gives only a typical transfer curve there. Verify translated LOW<0.8V at actual load, temperature and process. No guaranteed fast-fault timing claimed.

boot.review: Current upstream start_link drives resetGPIO0, enablesLTSSM, waits PCIE_T_PVPERL_MS, then drivesGPIO1. Treat resetGPIO polarity as implemented in the frozen image; do not assume generic active-low descriptor semantics here. DT supports-clkreq gates L1-substate handling.
boot.remaining: Freeze boot image/DTS; verify GPIO3_C1 polarity, M1 mux, bidirectional CLKREQ, WAKE, clock stabilization, endpoint discovery with worst420ms added delay, warm reset and resume. Driver/link-timeout compatibility not yet closed.
